What is the domain’s icon’s dhash?

Submit any of one of the ".onion" link

challenges.name: 6.2 APT-1
challenges.description:
Mandiant's APT-1 analysis was an unprecedented report that conclusively linked many attacks in the US to a specific threat actor that was very likely supported by the Chinese government to further Chinese interest. 

Read the report here.
https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/mandiant-apt1-report.pdf

Mandiant was able to attribute the attacks to a specific unit within the People’s Liberation Army (PLA). Based on the report, what is the name of the unit that Mandiant attributed the attacks to?
